headline: Hertha Berlin start the 2. Bundesliga season with a record unbeaten run
facts: Hertha beat Wolfsburg 2-1 at home on matchday 11 and have 31 points from 11 games, with 10 wins and one draw.
More than 70,000 fans came to the Olympiastadion; the only dropped points so far were a 0-0 draw at bottom club Holstein Kiel.
They have scored 25 goals and conceded 9, and the lead over second place is seven points; last season they needed 20 games to reach 31 points.
background: Hertha were relegated from the Bundesliga in 2023, and their last promotion to the top flight was 14 years ago, so a seventh promotion in club history is now within reach.

headline: Holstein Kiel sack Tim Walter after eight points from 11 games
facts: Kiel dismissed head coach Tim Walter and his assistants Julian Hubner and Michael Wimmer after a 2-1 home loss to Arminia Bielefeld.
The club is last in the 2. Bundesliga with eight points from 11 games: one win, five draws, five defeats.
Sporting director Olaf Rebbe called the start alarming and unsatisfactory for everyone involved.
background: Walter, 51, returned to Kiel in February 2026 to replace Marcel Rapp; he had coached the club before, from May 2018 to 2019, and finished 12th last season.

headline: Kiel hire Mitch Kniat, the man who took Bielefeld to a cup final, as new coach
facts: Mitch Kniat, 40, is the new Kiel head coach one day after Tim Walter was sacked; the loss to his former club Bielefeld was Walter's last game.
His first match is away at Wolfsburg on 21 November, and his first home game is against Kaiserslautern the week after.
Assistants Dani Jara and Janik Steringer join him; Kiel are last with eight points.
background: Kniat won promotion from the 3. Liga with Bielefeld in 2025 and led them to the 2025 DFB Cup final after knocking out holders Leverkusen, losing 4-2 to Stuttgart.
footage_terms: Mitch Kniat Arminia Bielefeld DFB-Pokal Halbfinale Leverkusen

headline: Greuther Fuerth members vote to drop the Greuther and go back to SpVgg Fuerth
facts: Members voted on 8 November 2026 to return to the name SpVgg Furth, with 1,867 votes in favour, 88.3 percent of those present.
The club needed 75 percent; the new name takes effect from the 2027/28 season.
A long-running fan initiative pushed for the change; some supporters see a special moment, others feel they lose a name that mattered to them.
background: The current name dates from a 1996 merger with TSV Vestenbergsgreuth.
footage_terms: Greuther Furth Namensaenderung SpVgg Furth Mitgliederversammlung

headline: Wolfsburg's Sael Kumbedi plays for France while in the second division
facts: Right-back Sael Kumbedi, 21, made his France debut as a 76th-minute substitute in a 3-1 Nations League loss in Italy after a surprise call-up from Zinedine Zidane.
He is the first active second-division player in almost 20 years to play a competitive match for France.
Wolfsburg are fifth in the 2. Bundesliga with 19 points.
background: The last comparable case was David Trezeguet, who played for Juventus in 2006/07, the season they started in Serie B after a relegation penalty.

headline: Nuernberg sporting director Joti Chatzialexiou leaves for Eintracht Frankfurt
facts: Chatzialexiou's time at Nuernberg ends on 30 November 2026; his contract originally ran to 31 January 2027, so both clubs agreed an early release.
He is moving to Eintracht Frankfurt, and the supervisory board already removed him from the sporting role, so he skipped the 17 November members' meeting.
Dieter Frey has handled sporting matters for about two weeks while Nuernberg sit second in the table.
background: Chatzialexiou spent roughly two and a half years at Nuernberg, who are promotion contenders under Miroslav Klose.

headline: Miroslav Klose has Nuernberg second in the 2. Bundesliga and praises Fuellkrug and Kane
facts: Nuernberg are second with 24 goals scored in ten games, and Klose credits team spirit, tough competition for places and trust in young players.
He says a team still needs a striker who scores and calls Harry Kane a role model for young players.
He also praises Niclas Fullkrug's current form.
background: Klose has coached Nuernberg since June 2024; as a player he won the 2014 World Cup with Germany at 36 and played for Kaiserslautern, Werder Bremen, Bayern Munich and five years at Lazio.
footage_terms: Miroslav Klose all goals World Cup

headline: Karlsruhe's Marvin Wanitzek wins October Goal of the Month again with a free kick
facts: Wanitzek won the 2. Bundesliga October Goal of the Month with a free kick into the corner against Heidenheim.
He took more than 30 percent of the fan vote, ahead of Fabian Reese and Felix Klaus.
It is his second monthly award of the season after his August win.
background: Karlsruhe are 16th in the 2. Bundesliga, in the relegation play-off place, after 11 matchdays.
footage_terms: Marvin Wanitzek Freistoss Tor Heidenheim Karlsruhe
Karlsruher SC Wanitzek free kick goal

headline: Bochum win 3-2 at home after Philipp Hofmann's stoppage-time winner
facts: Bochum came back from 2-1 down to beat Karlsruhe 3-2 on matchday 11.
Striker Philipp Hofmann scored twice, the second a stoppage-time winner.
It was Bochum's first home win of the season; they are eighth with 14 points.
background: Bochum are a former Bundesliga club now trying to climb back up the second tier; the table has them eighth.

headline: Magdeburg crush St. Pauli 4-1 as the Bundesliga's relegated club slide down
facts: Magdeburg scored three goals after the break to beat St. Pauli 4-1 and moved up to fourth place.
St. Pauli's Louis Oppie was sent off late in the game.
St. Pauli are ninth with 12 points from 11 games.
background: St. Pauli were relegated from the Bundesliga in the spring and are now fighting in the second tier, while Magdeburg sit on 20 points.

headline: Bremen and Hamburg prepare for the 111th Nordderby with Fuellkrug on nine goals
facts: The 111th Nordderby is at the Weserstadion on Sunday 22 November; Bremen are sixth, HSV are 11th, three points apart.
Fuellkrug leads the league with nine goals in nine games, six of them from set pieces, and Bremen have seven dead-ball goals, already more than last season.
Bremen are unbeaten at home this season and have won eight of their last nine home meetings with HSV; only three of HSV's 12 points came away from home.
background: HSV are back in the top flight after a seven-year absence, and coaches Daniel Thioune and Merlin Polzin worked together at Osnabrueck, winning promotion to the 2. Bundesliga in 2018/19.
footage_terms: Werder Bremen Hamburger SV Nordderby Highlights

headline: Nordderby security tightened after pyro fines and toilet vandalism at the last derby
facts: After pyrotechnics and toilet vandalism at the April derby, Werder expanded video surveillance, added fences and nets and plans about 2,000 staff on match day, with dogs searching for pyro.
Police are reinforced from other states; extra police costs at past derbies were between 230,000 and 450,000 euros and this one is expected to cost more.
Bremen's Interior Senator plans to pass part of the bill to the DFL, and Werder was fined 280,000 euros for the pyro at the previous derby.
background: The Bremen city state has been in a long dispute with the DFL about passing high-risk match police costs on to the league.
footage_terms: Werder Bremen Hamburger SV April 2026 Nordderby Highlights

headline: Fuellkrug's scoring run ends as Stuttgart edge Bremen 1-0
facts: Maximilian Mittelstaedt scored in the 7th minute from a Grischa Promel pass to give Stuttgart a 1-0 win.
Fuellkrug's run of seven straight games with a goal ended; Bremen had 21 shots but failed to score.
Stuttgart coach Sebastian Hoeness called it a needed win but admitted it was partly lucky, while Bremen coach Thioune felt his side deserved a point.
background: Bremen had been unbeaten in seven league games before this loss, and Fuellkrug has returned to the Germany squad.

headline: Leipzig destroy Augsburg 5-2 after Orban's blunder in his 400th Leipzig game
facts: Anton Kade scored for Augsburg in the first minute after a mistake by Willi Orban in his 400th Leipzig appearance.
Leipzig replied with five goals from Banzuzi, Nkunku, Raum, Romulo and Baumgartner; Brajan Gruda had two assists.
Leipzig reached 18 points; Augsburg have nine and have lost six leads this season and are seven league games without a win.
background: Leipzig are coached by Martin Demichelis and want to qualify for the Champions League every season.
footage_terms: Orban Fehler Kade Tor Leipzig Augsburg

headline: Brajan Gruda becomes Leipzig's dribbling machine on loan from Brighton
facts: Gruda has four assists in seven Bundesliga games this season, two of them in the 5-2 win over Augsburg, and the most successful dribbles in the league.
He has no league goal yet this season, but scored in the Champions League and DFB Cup; after returning in February he had three goals and three assists in 13 league games.
His loan from Brighton was extended through the 2026/27 season.
background: Gruda debuted in the Bundesliga at 18 for Mainz against Dortmund in 2023, then moved to Brighton, where he scored four goals in 45 appearances; he is 22.

headline: Maxime Esteve, Leipzig's new defender, jokes about two own goals against Man City
facts: French centre-back Esteve, 24, joined Leipzig from Burnley this summer and hopes to make his Champions League debut against Man City.
He scored two own goals for Burnley at the Etihad last year and calls the second one very unlucky.
He calls Haaland the best striker he has faced; Leipzig have won one of their first three Champions League games and are fourth in the Bundesliga.
background: Leipzig are coached by Martin Demichelis; Esteve's former Burnley manager Scott Parker praised his other work in the Man City match.

headline: Grischa Promel returns to hometown Stuttgart and scores on his home debut
facts: Promel, 31, born in Bad Cannstatt, joined Stuttgart from Hoffenheim this summer and scored in his first home game against Cologne.
He has played all nine league games, starting six, and says he is adapting to a less attacking role than at Hoffenheim.
Stuttgart have 12 points after nine games, with goals scored and conceded level at 15 each; next up are Schalke away, Frankfurt at home and Elversberg away.
background: Promel earlier played in the Bundesliga for Union Berlin and Hoffenheim; the interview says he is also a keen surfer and traveller.

headline: Stuttgart's Demirovic scores a Champions League hat-trick in 12 minutes against Viking
facts: Demirovic scored in the 20th, 26th and 32nd minutes for a 12-minute hat-trick in Stuttgart's Champions League game against Viking.
It was the first Champions League hat-trick of 2026-27, the first by a Stuttgart player and the fifth-earliest in competition history at 31 minutes 21 seconds.
Salah's treble for Liverpool against Rangers in October 2022 remains the fastest.
background: It was the first Bosnian hat-trick in the competition since Edin Dzeko for Roma in 2018, and Viking were making their first main-phase Champions League appearance. Older story, kept for background.
footage_terms: Demirovic hat-trick Stuttgart Viking Champions League

headline: Freiburg and Elversberg, the two overachievers, meet on matchday 10
facts: Freiburg are third with 19 points, their best start in the Bundesliga with a club-record 20 goals scored; only Bayern and Leverkusen have beaten them.
Elversberg are seventh with 13 points after wins over Leverkusen (3-2), at Gladbach (4-3), over Augsburg (4-3) and Mainz (4-1); coach Vincent Wagner still says the aim is 40 points.
The hosts play at a ground set to hold 15,000 after renovation, still the lowest capacity in the division.
background: Elversberg come from Spiesen-Elversberg, about 13,000 residents and the smallest town ever to host a Bundesliga club, and had spent only three seasons above the third tier. Freiburg's best finish is third, in 1994/95.

headline: Freiburg beat Union 2-0 as Union flirt with the relegation zone
facts: Rani Khedira scored an own goal for Union in the 55th minute and Yuito Suzuki added a second for Freiburg in the 68th.
Union goalkeeper Frederik Ronnow saved a late Vincenzo Grifo penalty and was the team's best player in a very weak performance.
Union coach Mauro Lustrinelli said courage was punished; the table puts Union 16th with seven points.
background: Union have already faced Leverkusen, Bayern and Dortmund this season; Freiburg moved up to third with this win.

headline: Union striker Latte Lath talks Messi, Carrick and his mental coach
facts: Latte Lath scored within three minutes of his Bundesliga debut for Union against Eintracht Frankfurt, then Union had a tough run.
He says his 22.5 million pound move from Middlesbrough to Atlanta in MLS brought heavy expectation and he felt he never showed his real level there.
He works with a mental coach and finds the Bundesliga a clear step up in intensity.
background: At Middlesbrough his coach was Michael Carrick, whom he describes as a calm coach who listened; in MLS he played against and met his idol Lionel Messi.
footage_terms: Emmanuel Latte Lath Union Berlin Tor Frankfurt Debuet

headline: The El Mala brothers share a flat and are Cologne's best double act
facts: Said El Mala has three Bundesliga goals this season, including the winner against Gladbach in the Rhine derby, and seven goals in his first 16 top-flight games.
Malek El Mala is a year older and about 10 cm taller; the brothers share a flat and have set up each other's goals, the first brother goal combination in the Bundesliga in 20 years.
Said wears Cologne's iconic number 10 shirt and earned his first senior Germany call-up in November 2025.
background: Gladbach released Said as a youngster in 2021; he considered quitting before his brother Malek encouraged him, then rebuilt at TSV Meerbusch and Viktoria Cologne, winning Newcomer of the Season in the 3. Liga in 2024/25.
footage_terms: Said El Mala Tor Koeln Leverkusen Malek Vorlage
Said El Mala Gladbach Derby Siegtor

headline: Spurs loanee Mikey Moore has no goals at Cologne and the club has gone 17 away games without a win
facts: Moore, 19, joined Cologne on a season-long loan from Tottenham and has five starts and 16 shots but no goals; only El Mala has more shots for the club.
He says the Bundesliga is as intense as the Premier League and wants to borrow El Mala's goalscoring touch while seeing Harry Kane as a role model.
Cologne are near the bottom and have gone 17 away games without a win, and Moore expects the visit to Bayern on matchday 10 to be the toughest game of his career so far.
background: Moore is a London-born striker who says the Cologne fans were part of the reason he chose the club.
footage_terms: 1. FC Koeln Bayern Muenchen Vorschau Moore

headline: Leverkusen beat Cologne 1-2 in a derby that ended in a brawl
facts: Aleix Garcia opened with a free kick from about 23 metres in the 7th minute; Patrik Schick sealed it in the 85th after an earlier goal was ruled out for handball.
Said El Mala pulled one back in the 90+2 minute from a cross by his brother Malek, and there was a brawl between the teams after the break.
Cologne stay on nine points and slide towards the relegation zone, while Leverkusen moved to 16 points after a run of defeats.
background: Cologne coach Rene Wagner is under fan pressure; Leverkusen coach Carles Martinez was credited with a controlled win, and defenders Quansah and Tapsoba largely shut down El Mala.
footage_terms: Aleix Garcia Freistoss Tor Koeln Leverkusen

headline: Patrik Schick has scored in six straight games for Leverkusen, a club record
facts: Schick scored in each of Leverkusen's first six league games this season, a club record.
He has 87 Bundesliga goals for Leverkusen, the most by any foreign player in club history, and could reach 100 soon.
He says he does not chase records and that scoring in a full stadium is what drives him.
background: Schick was once a more creative forward and chose to become a pure goalscorer around 23 or 24; Xabi Alonso and Florian Wirtz have left, making him the main attacking focus after the 2024 title and cup double.
footage_terms: Patrik Schick Tor Leverkusen Serie Rekord

headline: HSV beat Gladbach 3-1 with two long-range goals as Gladbach lose a man
facts: Miro Muheim scored from about 30 metres in the 11th minute and Albert Gronbaek added a long-range goal in the 70th, with Shafiq Nandja also scoring.
Joe Scally equalised for Gladbach in the 44th minute, but Ko Itakura was sent off with a second yellow in the 49th.
Gladbach stay bottom after another defeat, and HSV climbed into the top half.
background: HSV are back in the Bundesliga after a seven-year absence, and Muheim has three goals this season, all from outside the box.

headline: Gladbach coach Blessin to bench Moritz Nicolas for 35-year-old Daniel Batz before Dortmund
facts: Blessin has reportedly chosen Batz, 35, over Nicolas, 29, for the home game against Dortmund on Saturday at 15:30.
Batz covered for the injured Nicolas in three competitive games and kept a clean sheet in two of them, while Nicolas made mistakes early in the season.
Gladbach are last, and if Nicolas stays on the bench a transfer becomes more likely; Hull City showed interest in him in the summer.
background: Nicolas is a Gladbach academy product with 87 appearances in three seasons; Blessin said only that people should let themselves be surprised.

headline: Gladbach avoid a record seventh straight loss thanks to a Scally backheel
facts: Gladbach won 3-2 at Stuttgart on 23 October, ending a run of six straight defeats to open the season and avoiding a first-ever seven-loss start in the Bundesliga.
American defender Joe Scally equalised with a backheel before half-time and set up Wael Mohya's winning header; it was his fourth goal of the season.
Their goal difference had been a club-record minus 20 before the game and they remain at the bottom of the table.
background: Gladbach hired Alexander Blessin on 22 September on a deal to 2028 after sacking Eugen Polanski, and Blessin had been fired by St. Pauli in June after their relegation.

headline: A Frankfurt fan falls from the stands before Paderborn 2-2 Frankfurt
facts: Shortly before kick-off a Frankfurt fan fell from the stands in the away block and was taken to hospital in critical condition; a later report said he was responsive again.
Both sets of fans stayed silent for the full 90 minutes and furled their flags and banners.
The game ended 2-2: Burkardt scored twice, the second a heel flick from a corner in the third minute of stoppage time, with Frankfurt down to ten men after Elias Baum's second yellow.
background: Paderborn are 11th with 10 points and Frankfurt eighth with 12 after the draw; Frankfurt are coached by Adi Hutter.

headline: Karius hands Hoffenheim a goal as Schalke lose 2-1 at the bottom of the table
facts: Fisnik Asllani scored in the 10th minute after Schalke goalkeeper Loris Karius's pass hit him and deflected into the net; Tim Lemperle made it 2-0 in the 26th.
Junior Adamu pulled one back late after a parried Edin Dzeko header, the first goal by a Schalke striker this season.
Schalke created plenty of chances but wasted them and went into the international break in 17th place; Hoffenheim rose to eighth with 12 points.
background: Karius signed for second-division Schalke from Liverpool in 2024, and 40-year-old Edin Dzeko helped Schalke win promotion with a 1-0 over Fortuna Duesseldorf.

headline: Schalke's crisis: 17th place, six points, five goals and Bayern interest in Karius
facts: Schalke are 17th with six points from nine games and only five goals scored; only nine of 23 shots in the latest game hit the target.
Coach Miron Muslic's more attacking approach is seen as the right move, but the team needs a centre-forward and a creative midfielder, and Leverkusen defender Tim Oermann is reportedly a loan option.
Karius reportedly attracted Bayern interest, but chief executive Matthias Tillmann said being number one at Schalke beats being a backup elsewhere.
background: Schalke are back in the Bundesliga after promotion last season under Muslic, and host Stuttgart on Saturday.

headline: Goalkeeper Noah Atubolu saves a sixth straight Bundesliga penalty for Frankfurt
facts: Atubolu saved a penalty in the Rhine-Main derby in gameweek three, his sixth in a row, a Bundesliga goalkeeper record.
He has not been beaten from the spot since May 2024 and is on loan at Frankfurt from Freiburg after spending pre-season away from the first team.
Reports say Germany coach Julian Nagelsmann is considering him for a senior call-up.
background: Atubolu, 24, from Freiburg with German and Nigerian heritage, was Freiburg's number one from 2023-24 and reached the U-21 Euro final in 2025, lost to England. Older story, kept for background.
